summary: Ten fresh heading/start counterfactuals reuse one unchanged actual IMG_5641 gateway support/theta field. Exact native baseline and S5 rawtraces reproduce 27.75 and 64.75 canonical px and match prior source/config/canonical/field/tracer identities. All ten variants abstain UNKNOWN with no basket.
